name: Multiscale Tensor Decomposition
definition: A scheme to represent scenes from coarse to fine scales by decomposing 3D tensors into plane and line features at multiple resolutions, improving shape/appearance reconstruction and convergence speed over single-scale TensoRF while using fewer parameters.
summary: Multiscale Tensor Decomposition is a radiance field method that decomposes 3D tensors into plane and line features across multiple resolutions to improve reconstruction accuracy and convergence over single-scale approaches.
